classification: portfolio slot-replacement screen of R391 statistical candidates; no promotion
portfolio_base_reason: core_v1 contains matrix-incompatible custom factors; P5 multi_dimension_v1 is the validated matrix-compatible baseline

grid.selection_rule: per candidate, choose replacement slot with highest train 2x annual; test is evaluation only

known_limits: Only the R391 statistical pass set is evaluated.
Portfolio MC uses daily T+1 approximation.
Current HS300 membership applied to history retains survivorship bias.
5x is warning only and cannot hard-reject.
